independent_induction_proof.symmetry_and_commutativity: inherited since previous components commute and I,J,Q commute and are symmetric
independent_induction_proof.entry_test: for paired signs a,b, exactly one of(a-b)/2,(a+b)/2 is nonzero; on the diagonal the Q term vanishes, off the diagonal the I term vanishes, giving only signs

scalar_restriction.trace: normalized regular trace: coefficient of identity=(1/w_r)*sum of all cyclotomic field traces, with recorded multiplicities
scalar_restriction.metric: I_w in the inverse-group basis; factor power-basis blocks are RamanujanSum_d(j-i)/w_r
scalar_restriction.complete_weighted_OD_source: D_T(A_0,...,A_3), order4*631 over the group algebra and Gram4*631*w_rI
scalar_restriction.actual_source_entry_alphabet: +/-the four recorded group polynomials A_j; weighted, not asserted Butson
scalar_restriction.zero_policy: zero entries in individual cyclotomic factors are retained; the complete inverse-group basis reconstruction has only sign entries
